signIn.title: Studio Sign In
signIn.description: Sign in to access your photography studio dashboard.
signIn.mfaDescription: Enter the 6-digit verification code from your authenticator app.
signIn.passkeyNotSupported: Passkeys are not supported on this device.

forgotPassword.title: Forgot Password
forgotPassword.description: Enter your email address to receive a secure password reset link.
forgotPassword.successMessage: If an account exists for this email address, a password reset link has been dispatched.

resetPassword.title: Reset Password
resetPassword.description: Enter your new password to regain access to your account.
resetPassword.successMessage: Your password has been changed. You can now sign in with your new credentials.

verifyEmail.title: Email Verification
verifyEmail.description: Verify your email address for secure communications.
verifyEmail.instruction: Please click the link sent to your email to verify your address.
verifyEmail.statusVerified: Your email address has been verified successfully.

security.title: Security & Multi-Factor Authentication
security.description: Manage your two-factor authentication, passkeys, recovery codes, and active sessions.
security.totpDescription: Use an authenticator application (such as Google Authenticator, 1Password, or Bitwarden) for multi-factor authentication.
security.totpSetupInstructions: Scan the QR code below with your authenticator application, or manually enter the secret key.
security.qrCodeAlt: QR Code for TOTP authenticator enrolment
security.recoveryCodesDescription: Save these 10 recovery codes in a safe place. Each code can only be used once if you lose access to your authenticator device.
security.recoveryCodesWarning: These codes are displayed once and cannot be viewed again. Please copy or download them now.
security.confirmRecoveryCodes: I have safely stored these codes
security.passkeysDescription: Sign in passwordlessly and securely using biometrics (Touch ID, Face ID, Windows Hello) or hardware security keys.
security.sessionsDescription: Manage and revoke active sessions logged in to your studio.
security.reauthDescription: For your security, please confirm your master password before performing this sensitive operation.
security.mfaEnforcedAlert: Multi-factor authentication is required by studio policy. Please configure an authenticator app or passkey before accessing other studio features.
security.mfaPostponeNotice: Multi-factor authentication will become mandatory on {date}.

errors.INVALID_RECOVERY_CODE: Invalid recovery code. Each recovery code can only be used once.
